title: Section Modulus - Unit Converter
description: Convert between Elastic Section Modulus units (m³, cm³, ft³, in³)

components.content:
## Section Modulus - Unit Converter

The **Elastic Section Modulus** of a beam is the ratio of the cross section Area Moment of Inertia to its greatest distance from the neutral axis.

For a simple solid Square the Section Modulus can be expressed as:

**Sx = Sy = a³ / 6**

where:
- **S** = Elastic Section Modulus (m³, cm³, ft³, in³)
- **a** = square side distance (m, in, ft, etc.)

outputs.label: Converted Value
outputs.formula: inputs.value * (inputs.from_unit === 'in3' && inputs.to_unit === 'cm3' ? 16.38 : inputs.from_unit === 'in3' && inputs.to_unit === 'ft3' ? 5.78e-4 : inputs.from_unit === 'in3' && inputs.to_unit === 'm3' ? 0.00001638706 : inputs.from_unit === 'cm3' && inputs.to_unit === 'in3' ? 0.061 : inputs.from_unit === 'cm3' && inputs.to_unit === 'ft3' ? 3.5e-5 : inputs.from_unit === 'cm3' && inputs.to_unit === 'm3' ? 1e-6 : inputs.from_unit === 'ft3' && inputs.to_unit === 'in3' ? 1728 : inputs.from_unit === 'ft3' && inputs.to_unit === 'cm3' ? 28373 : inputs.from_unit === 'ft3' && inputs.to_unit === 'm3' ? 0.02831685 : inputs.from_unit === 'm3' && inputs.to_unit === 'in3' ? 61023.76 : inputs.from_unit === 'm3' && inputs.to_unit === 'cm3' ? 1000000 : inputs.from_unit === 'm3' && inputs.to_unit === 'ft3' ? 35.31466 : 1)

components.content:
## Example

**Convert 12 in³ to cm³**

12 in³ × 16.38 cm³/in³ = **196.6 cm³**
